gloss_en: Yir'ah — fear/awe of Heaven: the devotional quality of reverence before God (identified in Likutey Moharan with Malkhut, earth, prayer, and the vessel that receives blessing); the noun יִרְאָה, not the verb יִרְאֶה 'he will see' and not רֵאָה 'lung'

outliers.actual_gloss_en: 'he will see / will be seen' (verb from ראה, seeing — associated with direct light, or ha-yashar)
outliers.reason: Explicitly vocalized יִרְאֶה in the proof ('יִרְאֶה הוּא בְחִינַת אוֹר הַיָּשָׁר'); a homograph of seeing, not the noun fear.

outliers.actual_gloss_en: the lung (re'ah), which 'illuminates the eyes' and renews the world via the breath of its wings
outliers.reason: Proof text concerns הָרֵאָה the lung (Chullin 49) and contains no יִרְאָה; likely letter-match mis-assignment.

outliers.actual_gloss_en: the lung (re'ah) as source of renewal/nourishment imagery
outliers.reason: Same lung passage (הָרֵאָה, Chullin 49); the shown proof does not carry the sense 'fear of God'.
